component.name: LLCV
component.summary: Low-latency viewer for HDMI capture devices
HDMIキャプチャデバイス向けの低遅延ビューアー
Visor de baja latencia para dispositivos de captura HDMI
Visualizador de baixa latência para dispositivos de captura HDMI

description.p: LLCV shows video and audio from USB (UVC/V4L2) HDMI capture devices, such as the AVerMedia Live Gamer ULTRA S GC553Pro, with minimal delay. Stale frames are dropped in favor of the newest frame, and capture audio is played through PipeWire with a small, drift-corrected buffer.

ul.li: NV12, YUY2, MJPEG, BGR24 and P010 (HDR10) capture modes
HDR10 passthrough on Wayland, HDR to SDR tone mapping elsewhere
Immediate or VSync presentation with OpenGL
Audio-only mode, volume boost and background mute
Source-resolution PNG screenshots and live diagnostics
Wayland by default, with an optional X11 (XWayland) mode
Keyboard shortcuts can be changed under Settings, Guide and logs, including Esc.
Ctrl, Alt and Shift combinations are supported. Reset defaults restores all keys.
Help, menu bar, overlays and settings show the assigned keys.

description.p: Follows the Windows LLCV 2.0.3 and 2.0.4 updates.

ul.li: Optional 40 fps capture, confirmed against the rate the driver reports.
Prevent sleep during playback, on by default. Audio-only lets the display turn off.
A failed settings save keeps the previous settings file and shows a notice.

description.p: First Linux release: V4L2 capture, OpenGL presentation, SDL3/PipeWire audio.
